d:
Dhanteras dipavli ke shubh avsar par sabhi bhakton ko hardik shubhkamnaen.
Shri mahalakshmi stotr sangrah | Shree Mahalakshmi Stotra Sangrah | Lakshmi Stotram | Deepawali Special
Dipavli ke pavan avsar par man mahalakshmi ki aaradhna aur stuti ke lie sunen shri mahalakshmi stotron ka yah vishesh sangraha. ismen man lakshmi ki mahima ka gungan karne vali divy aarti, ashtalakshmi stotr, kanakdhara stotr, lakshmi sahasranam, ashtalakshmi shlok aur shri sukt shamil hain.
Shraddha aur bhaktibhav ke sath in pavitr stotron ka shravan karen aur man mahalakshmi ka aashirvad prapt karen.
